conditioning/01-overlap-circles-small-an.exclusion-is-union-minus-intersection: Two overlapping circles are treated as disjoint under the `small-and-far` conditioning (a scene 2e-3 across at an offset of 1e6). |A u B| comes out as 3.14e-6, one circle, while the three parts sum to 9.42e-6, three circles; the raster oracle disagrees on 7% of compared pixels. Same precision limit as `conditioning/03-edge-shared-full-small-and-far`, and the same note applies: each conditioning passes on its own.

conditioning/03-edge-shared-full-small-a.commutative-exclusion: Throws `No outer face of a component found` under the `small-and-far` conditioning — a scene 2e-3 across sitting at an offset of 1e6, where neighbouring doubles are ~2e-10 apart. Each conditioning on its own passes (`-small` and `-far` are both green), so it is the combination that loses the precision. `config.ts` is explicit that a large offset is a known separate problem that widening tolerances would conceal rather than cure, so this documents the limit rather than proposing to move it. In the production bundle it throws a raw TypeError from `WeakSet.add` in `flagFaces`.

malformed/duplicate-opposite-winding-bou.union-is-sum-of-its-three-parts: Cancelling opposite-winding copies of A share an edge with B. Forward selection leaves an open boundary and area 1200 instead of 800; swapping inputs changes the answer. |A u B| vs |A \ B| + |A n B| + |B \ A|: 1200.00000000 vs 800.000000000, off by 4.000e+2 (tolerance 1.200e-4)
malformed/duplicate-opposite-winding-bou.commutative-union: Cancelling opposite-winding copies of A share an edge with B. Forward selection leaves an open boundary and area 1200 instead of 800; swapping inputs changes the answer. |A u B| vs |B u A|: 1200.00000000 vs 800.000000000, off by 4.000e+2 (tolerance 1.200e-4)
malformed/duplicate-opposite-winding-bou.commutative-exclusion: Cancelling opposite-winding copies of A share an edge with B. Forward selection leaves an open boundary and area 1200 instead of 800; swapping inputs changes the answer. |A xor B| vs |B xor A|: 1200.00000000 vs 800.000000000, off by 4.000e+2 (tolerance 1.200e-4)
malformed/duplicate-opposite-winding-bou.commutative-fracture: Cancelling opposite-winding copies of A share an edge with B. Forward selection leaves an open boundary and area 1200 instead of 800; swapping inputs changes the answer. Fracture face 0 of 1 (sorted by area): 1200.00000000 vs 800.000000000, off by 4.000e+2 (tolerance 1.200e-4)

malformed/sliver-0.000001.partition-orientation: A 1e-6-wide sliver produces a fracture face with opposite orientation (area 2.5e-6 versus the main face -1200). The partition orientation oracle detects it below raster resolution.
